svg.title: Zarvyn target architecture (planned)
svg.text: Multi-tenant secrets platform for MSPs, with credential use for AI agents that never exposes the secret.
no tenant reads another tenant's data

g.text: the agent gets only the result

svg.text: secret never returned to the agent
Design target, not current state · fictional company, synthetic data
Fastest path: technician or agent → gateway or MCP → policy + approval → cell → broker uses the secret → result + evidence.
